format:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Be+Vietnam+Pro:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;0,900;1,400;1,600&subset=vietnamese&display=swap');

  /* ============================================================== */
  /* DESIGN SYSTEM — DARK INDUSTRIAL COMMAND CENTER                 */
  /* ============================================================== */
  :root {
    --bg-app: #070D18;
    --panel-main: #0C1525;
    --panel-secondary: #101D30;
    --panel-elevated: #142238;
    --cyan-primary: #26C6F4;
    --cyan-hover: #59D8FF;
    --cyan-muted: #16445B;
    --text-primary: #E8F1FC;
    --text-secondary: #91A4BD;
    --text-muted: #637791;
    --color-success: #31D6A0;
    --color-warning: #F6B94B;
    --color-danger: #FF5B68;
    --border-neutral: #1D3048;
    --border-active: #26C6F4;
    --font-sans: 'Segoe UI', 'Be Vietnam Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-mono: 'Consolas', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
  }

  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  /* Zero-scrollbar container reset for Node-RED Dashboard */
  html, body, #nr-dashboard, md-content, .nr-dashboard-theme {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    max-height: 100vh !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    background-color: var(--bg-app) !important;
    color: var(--text-primary) !important;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Be Vietnam Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    overflow-y: hidden !important;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  #Tab_Bảng_điều_khiển,
  .masonry-container,
  .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer,
  .nr-dashboard-cardpanel,
  ui-card-panel,
  md-card.nr-dashboard-template,
  .nr-dashboard-card {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100vw !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
  }

  
  /* ============================================================== */
  /* BULLETPROOF VIETNAMESE TYPOGRAPHY OVERRIDE                     */
  /* ============================================================== */
  .scada-command-center,
  .scada-command-center *,
  .scada-command-center button,
  .scada-command-center input,
  .scada-command-center select,
  .scada-command-center textarea,
  .scada-command-center .md-button,
  .scada-command-center .nav-item-btn,
  .scada-command-center .nav-item-label,
  .scada-command-center .section-title,
  .scada-command-center .btn-cmd,
  .scada-command-center .top-bar,
  .scada-command-center .sidebar-panel {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Be Vietnam Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif !important;
  }

  .scada-command-center .font-mono,
  .scada-command-center .kpi-stat-val,
  .scada-command-center .status-pill,
  .scada-command-center .mode-badge,
  .scada-command-center .top-timestamp,
  .scada-command-center .nav-badge-pill,
  .scada-command-center .terminal-code,
  .scada-command-center .modbus-mini-table,
  .scada-command-center .scada-table th,
  .scada-command-center code,
  .scada-command-center pre {
    font-family: 'Consolas', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace !important;
  }

  /* App Shell Container */
    /* ============================================================== */
  /* COMPLETE ELIMINATION OF DEFAULT NODE-RED TOOLBAR ("Bảng điều khiển") */
  /* ============================================================== */
  md-toolbar,
  md-toolbar#toolbar,
  .md-toolbar-tools,
  #nr-dashboard-toolbar,
  header.nr-dashboard-toolbar {
    display: none !important;
    height: 0px !important;
    min-height: 0px !important;
    max-height: 0px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    border: none !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  html, body, #nr-dashboard, md-content, section.layout-row {
    height: 100vh !important;
    max-height: 100vh !important;
    min-height: 100vh !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    background: var(--bg-app) !important;
  }

  .masonry-container,
  .nr-dashboard-cardpanel,
  .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer,
  md-card.nr-dashboard-template,
  ui-card-panel {
    height: 100vh !important;
    max-height: 100vh !important;
    min-height: 100vh !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    border: none !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;
    background: var(--bg-app) !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  .scada-command-center {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
    max-height: 100vh !important;
    min-height: 100vh !important;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--bg-app);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    user-select: none;
    top: 0 !important;
  }

  /* ============================================================== */
  /* TOP BAR                                                        */
  /* ============================================================== */
  .top-bar {
    height: 48px;
    min-height: 48px;
    max-height: 48px;
    background: var(--panel-main);
    border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--border-neutral);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  }

  .top-bar-left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .system-logo-badge {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, var(--cyan-primary));
    color: #ffffff;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 13px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.4);
  }
  .system-title-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .breadcrumb-sep {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .breadcrumb-page {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .top-bar-right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .status-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }
  .status-pill.online {
    background: rgba(49, 214, 160, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-success);
    color: var(--color-success);
  }
  .status-pill.offline {
    background: rgba(255, 91, 104, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-danger);
    color: var(--color-danger);
  }
  .status-dot-pulse {
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: statusPulse 1.4s infinite ease-in-out;
  }
  @keyframes statusPulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.85); }
  }

  .mode-badge {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
  }
  .mode-badge.auto {
    background: rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid var(--cyan-primary);
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
  }
  .mode-badge.manual {
    background: rgba(246, 185, 75, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-warning);
    color: var(--color-warning);
  }

  .top-timestamp {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }

  .btn-estop-header {
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444 0%, #b91c1c 100%);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--color-danger);
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 91, 104, 0.5);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    transition: all 0.15s ease-in-out;
  }
  .btn-estop-header:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 91, 104, 0.8);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .btn-estop-header.tripped {
    background: #7f1d1d;
    border-color: #fca5a5;
    animation: estopFlash 0.7s infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes estopFlash {
    0% { box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--color-danger); }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 22px var(--color-danger); }
  }

  /* ============================================================== */
  /* MAIN BODY LAYOUT: SIDEBAR + VIEWPORT                           */
  /* ============================================================== */
  .scada-body-layout {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100vh - 48px) !important;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 48px) !important;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* SIDEBAR */
  .scada-sidebar {
    width: 220px;
    min-width: 220px;
    background: var(--panel-main);
    border-right: 1.5px solid var(--border-neutral);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    transition: width 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), min-width 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    z-index: 40;
  }
  .scada-sidebar.is-collapsed {
    width: 60px;
    min-width: 60px;
  }

  .sidebar-nav-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 10px 8px;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .nav-item-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.18s ease;
    text-align: left;
    white-space: nowrap;
    position: relative;
  }
  .nav-item-btn:hover {
    background: var(--panel-secondary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    border-color: rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.2);
  }
  .nav-item-btn.is-active {
    background: var(--panel-elevated);
    border-color: var(--cyan-primary);
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
    font-weight: 700;
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.18);
  }
  .nav-item-icon {
    font-size: 14px;
    width: 20px;
    text-align: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .nav-item-label {
    flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .nav-badge-pill {
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
  }
  .badge-danger {
    background: rgba(255, 91, 104, 0.2);
    color: var(--color-danger);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-danger);
  }

  .sidebar-bottom-controls {
    padding: 8px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);
  }
  .btn-sidebar-toggle {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-secondary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .btn-sidebar-toggle:hover {
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
    border-color: var(--cyan-primary);
  }

  /* VIEWPORT CONTAINER */
  .scada-viewport {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    background: var(--bg-app);
    position: relative;
    padding: 12px 16px;
  }

  /* ============================================================== */
  /* COMMON CARDS & TYPOGRAPHY                                      */
  /* ============================================================== */
  .card-panel {
    background: var(--panel-main);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-neutral);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    position: relative;
  }
  .card-panel.elevated {
    background: var(--panel-secondary);
    border-color: rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.25);
  }

  .section-header-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    padding-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(29, 48, 72, 0.8);
  }
  .section-title {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .section-title-icon {
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  /* KPI Cards Grid (Upgraded 2-Row Layout & Proportions) */
  .kpi-row-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .kpi-stat-card {
    background: var(--panel-main);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-neutral);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    min-height: 82px;
    min-width: 0;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .kpi-stat-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--cyan-primary);
    background: var(--panel-secondary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.2);
  }
  .kpi-card-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .kpi-stat-label {
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  }
  .kpi-sparkline {
    width: 64px;
    height: 22px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .kpi-card-bottom {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 6px;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .kpi-stat-val {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 5px;
    line-height: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .kpi-stat-val .kpi-num {
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
  }
  .kpi-stat-unit {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .kpi-stat-sub {
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    text-align: right;
    flex-shrink: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* Sleek Scrollbars (Single primary vertical scroll in viewport) */
  .scada-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar,
  .sidebar-nav-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
  }
  .scada-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar-track,
  .sidebar-nav-list::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: var(--bg-app);
  }
  .scada-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
  .sidebar-nav-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.25);
    border-radius: 3px;
  }
  .scada-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
  .sidebar-nav-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: var(--cyan-primary);
  }

  /* Responsive Rules across 1920, 1600, 1440, 1366, 1280 */
  @media (max-width: 1440px) {
    .kpi-stat-val .kpi-num {
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    .kpi-stat-label {
      font-size: 9px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 1200px) {
    .kpi-row-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .overview-main-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    }
    .overview-bottom-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    }
  }

  /* Buttons */
  .btn-cmd {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 800;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: all 0.18s ease;
    user-select: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn-cmd.primary {
    background: rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.18);
    border-color: var(--cyan-primary);
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
  }
  .btn-cmd.primary:hover {
    background: var(--cyan-primary);
    color: #000000;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.5);
  }
  .btn-cmd.success {
    background: rgba(49, 214, 160, 0.18);
    border-color: var(--color-success);
    color: var(--color-success);
  }
  .btn-cmd.success:hover {
    background: var(--color-success);
    color: #000000;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(49, 214, 160, 0.5);
  }
  .btn-cmd.warning {
    background: rgba(246, 185, 75, 0.18);
    border-color: var(--color-warning);
    color: var(--color-warning);
  }
  .btn-cmd.warning:hover {
    background: var(--color-warning);
    color: #000000;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(246, 185, 75, 0.5);
  }
  .btn-cmd.danger {
    background: rgba(255, 91, 104, 0.18);
    border-color: var(--color-danger);
    color: var(--color-danger);
  }
  .btn-cmd.danger:hover {
    background: var(--color-danger);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 91, 104, 0.5);
  }
  .btn-cmd.disabled {
    opacity: 0.35 !important;
    cursor: not-allowed !important;
    background: var(--panel-elevated) !important;
    border-color: var(--border-neutral) !important;
    color: var(--text-muted) !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  /* Data Table */
  .scada-table-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--panel-main);
  }
  .scada-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    text-align: left;
  }
  .scada-table th {
    background: var(--panel-secondary);
    padding: 8px 10px;
    color: var(--cyan-primary);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--border-neutral);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .scada-table td {
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(29, 48, 72, 0.6);
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
  .scada-table tr:hover {
    background: rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.08);
  }

  /* Toast Notification */
  .toast-container {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 20px;
    right: 20px;
    z-index: 999;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .toast-item {
    background: var(--panel-elevated);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--cyan-primary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 15px rgba(38, 198, 244, 0.3);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    animation: toastPop 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }
  @keyframes toastPop {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  /* Dialog Modal */
  .scada-dialog-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    background: rgba(7, 13, 24, 0.8);
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    z-index: 500;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
  }
  .scada-dialog-box {
    width: 500px;
    max-width: 90vw;
    background: var(--panel-main);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--cyan-primary);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .dialog-top {
    height: 40px;

        <div class="dialog-actions" style="margin-top: 10px;">

          <button class="btn-cmd primary" ng-click="verifyFactoryClearPin()">Tiếp Tục (Bước 2/2) ↗</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- BƯỚC 2: CẢNH BÁO RỦI RO & CHECKLIST XÁC NHẬN CUỐI -->
      <div class="dialog-body" ng-if="factoryClearStep === 2" style="padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-size: 10px;">
        <div style="background: rgba(255,91,104,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--color-danger); padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4;">
          ▲ CẢNH BÁO RỦI RO CAO: Thao tác này sẽ xóa vĩnh viễn dữ liệu phiên sản xuất hiện tại. Các mục sau đây sẽ được đưa về giá trị 0 mặc định:
        </div>
        <ul style="color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.6;">
          <li>Bộ đếm sản lượng phôi Fe: Đưa về <b>0 phôi</b></li>
          <li>Toàn bộ nhật ký gói tin Modbus RTU Sniffer: <b>Xóa sạch</b></li>
          <li>Lịch sử chu kỳ và biểu đồ hiệu suất: <b>Làm mới về 3.8s chuẩn</b></li>
          <li>Cảnh báo nhiệt độ và trạng thái E-Stop: <b>Khôi phục định mức 30.0°C</b></li>
          <li>Ghi nhật ký Audit Trail: <b>Ghi lại danh tính Administrator & thời gian</b></li>
        </ul>
        <div class="dialog-actions" style="margin-top: 10px;">
          <button class="btn-cmd" style="background: var(--panel-elevated); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);" ng-click="factoryClearStep = 1">← Quay Lại</button>
          <button class="btn-cmd danger" ng-click="confirmFactoryClearFinal()">TÔI XÁC NHẬN RESET TOÀN BỘ (FACTORY CLEAR)</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- MODAL: NHẬP PIN MỞ KHÓA SETTINGS -->
  <div class="scada-dialog-backdrop" ng-if="showPinModal" ng-click="showPinModal = false">
    <div class="scada-dialog-box" style="width: 400px;" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="dialog-top">
        <div style="font-weight: 800; color: #fff;">XÁC THỰC KỸ THUẬT VIÊN</div>
        <button style="background: none; border: none; color: #fff; cursor: pointer;" ng-click="showPinModal = false">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="dialog-body" style="padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 10px;">
        <div>Nhập mã PIN kỹ thuật viên để mở quyền chỉnh sửa tham số hệ thống (Mặc định: 9999):</div>
        <input type="password" ng-model="settingsPinInput" placeholder="Mã PIN..." style="background: #040812; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral); color: #fff; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; font-family: var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 4px;">
        <div ng-if="settingsPinError" style="color: var(--color-danger); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700;">▲ {{settingsPinError}}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="dialog-actions">
        <button class="btn-cmd" style="background: var(--panel-elevated); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-neutral);" ng-click="showPinModal = false">Hủy</button>
        <button class="btn-cmd primary" ng-click="confirmSettingsPin()">Mở Khóa Cấu Hình</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function(scope) {
  scope = scope || window.scope;
  if (!scope && typeof angular !== 'undefined') {
    const el = document.querySelector('.scada-command-center');
    if (el) scope = angular.element(el).scope();
  }
  if (!scope) scope = {};
  window.__scada_scope = scope;
  console.log("=== SCADA V2 SCRIPT EXECUTING! ===", scope);
  window.__scada_scope = scope;
  // ==============================================================
  // 1. STATE INITIALIZATION (SCADA V2 SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH)
  // ==============================================================
  scope.activeTab = 'overview';
  scope.monitoringSubTab = 'analytics';
  scope.systemSubTab = 'settings';
  scope.sidebarCollapsed = false;
  scope.modbusOnline = true;
  scope.isSimulating = false;
  scope.systemMode = 'AUTO'; // 'AUTO' | 'MANUAL'
  scope.conveyorRunning = false;
  scope.isEstopTripped = false;
  scope.sensorActive = false;
  scope.solenoidActive = false;
  scope.solenoidHeld = false;
  scope.solenoidTemp = 30.0;
  scope.feCount = 0; // Starts at 0
  scope.lastSensorTime = '11:20:00';
  scope.lastUpdateTime = '11:20:00.120';
  scope.toastMsg = '';
  scope.isModbusPaused = false;
  scope.txCount = 1420;
  scope.rxCount = 1420;
  scope.reconnectCount = 1;
  scope.commFailureCount = 0;

  // Timers
  scope.motorRunSeconds = 142 * 3600 + 30 * 60; // 142.5 hours baseline
  scope.machineStopSeconds = 480;
  scope.disconnectSeconds = 0;

  // Process & Workpiece Lifecycle
  scope.currentProcessState = 'WAITING'; // 'WAITING', 'DETECTING', 'CLASSIFYING', 'DIVERTING', 'COMPLETED'
  scope.currentWorkpieceType = 'Fe'; // 'Fe' | 'Non-Fe'
  scope.cycleElapsedSec = 0.0;
  scope.boxVisible = false;
  scope.boxX = 0;
  scope.boxY = 115;
  let animFrameId = null;
  let deadmanWatchdogTimer = null;

  // Filters
  scope.modbusFilterDir = 'ALL';
  scope.modbusFilterFC = 'ALL';
  scope.modbusSearchText = '';
  scope.alarmFilterGroup = 'ALL';
  scope.analyticsShiftFilter = 'ALL';
  scope.analyticsDateFilter = 'TODAY';

  // Security & Factory Clear
  scope.showConfirmDialog = false;
  scope.factoryClearStep = 1;
  scope.factoryClearPinInput = '';
  scope.factoryClearError = '';
  scope.showPinModal = false;
  scope.settingsUnlocked = false;
  scope.settingsPinInput = '';
  scope.settingsPinError = '';
  scope.isSettingsDirty = false;

  // Inspector modals
  scope.selectedPacket = null;
  scope.selectedAlarm = null;

  // Recent 5 events feed
  scope.recentEvents = [
    { time: '11:25:40', cat: 'MODBUS', type: 'info', text: 'Đồng bộ thanh ghi COM4 9600-8N1 thành công' },
    { time: '11:24:12', cat: 'SENSOR', type: 'success', text: 'Cảm biến LJ12A3 phát hiện phôi kim loại Fe #24' },
    { time: '11:24:14', cat: 'SOLENOID', type: 'info', text: 'Cơ cấu Solenoid kích hoạt chu kỳ gạt 4 nhịp' },
    { time: '11:22:05', cat: 'MOTOR', type: 'success', text: 'Động cơ 24VDC phản hồi RUNNING định mức' },
    { time: '11:20:00', cat: 'SYSTEM', type: 'info', text: 'Khởi động trạm Industrial Command Center V2' }
  ];

  function addRecentEvent(cat, type, text) {
    scope.recentEvents.unshift({
      time: getTimestamp().split('.')[0],
      cat: cat,
      type: type,
      text: text
    });
    if (scope.recentEvents.length > 5) scope.recentEvents.pop();
  }

  // 10-bar cycle histogram
  scope.cycleBars = [
    { val: 4.1, h: 65 },
    { val: 3.8, h: 55 },
    { val: 3.9, h: 58 },
    { val: 3.6, h: 50 },
    { val: 3.8, h: 55 },
    { val: 4.2, h: 68 },
    { val: 3.7, h: 53 },
    { val: 3.8, h: 55 },
    { val: 3.9, h: 58 },
    { val: 3.8, h: 55 }
  ];

  // Modbus transaction log
  scope.modbusLogs = [
    { time: '11:25:40.150', dir: 'TX', slaveId: '01', fc: 'FC02 (Read Discrete)', addr: '0x0000', data: 'Len: 2 (IN1, IN2)', status: 'OK [CRC Valid]', latency: 18 },
    { time: '11:25:40.185', dir: 'RX', slaveId: '01', fc: 'FC02 (Read Discrete)', addr: '0x0000', data: '01 02 01 01 60 48 [IN1=1]', status: 'OK [CRC Valid]', latency: 22 },
    { time: '11:25:42.300', dir: 'TX', slaveId: '01', fc: 'FC05 (Write Coil)', addr: '0x0001', data: 'FF 00 (Solenoid ON)', status: 'OK [CRC Valid]', latency: 19 },
    { time: '11:25:42.335', dir: 'RX', slaveId: '01', fc: 'FC05 (Write Coil)', addr: '0x0001', data: '01 05 00 01 FF 00 DD FA', status: 'OK [CRC Valid]', latency: 25 },
    { time: '11:25:44.100', dir: 'TX', slaveId: '01', fc: 'FC05 (Write Coil)', addr: '0x0001', data: '00 00 (Solenoid OFF)', status: 'OK [CRC Valid]', latency: 18 },
    { time: '11:25:44.135', dir: 'RX', slaveId: '01', fc: 'FC05 (Write Coil)', addr: '0x0001', data: '01 05 00 01 00 00 9C 0A', status: 'OK [CRC Valid]', latency: 21 }
  ];

  // Alarms list
  scope.alarmsList = [
    { code: 'ALM-THRM-001', level: 'WARNING', group: 'THERMAL', time: '11:20:00', desc: 'Nhiệt độ Solenoid vượt 45°C', active: false, ack: true, recoveryTime: '11:22:15', remedy: 'Kiểm tra quạt tản nhiệt hoặc tăng thời gian nghỉ' },
    { code: 'ALM-COMM-001', level: 'INFO', group: 'COMM', time: '11:15:10', desc: 'Modbus RTU kết nối COM4 thành công', active: false, ack: true, recoveryTime: '11:15:10', remedy: 'Không yêu cầu thao tác' }
  ];
  scope.unackAlarmsCount = 0;

  // Audit trail log
  scope.auditLogs = [
    { time: '11:25:40', actor: 'Operator', category: 'CONTROL', desc: 'Bơm phôi thử nghiệm qua cảm biến', result: 'Thành công' },
    { time: '11:22:05', actor: 'Engineer', category: 'MODE', desc: 'Chuyển sang chế độ TỰ ĐỘNG', result: 'Đã lưu' },
    { time: '11:20:00', actor: 'System', category: 'INIT', desc: 'Khởi động trạm giám sát Command Center V2', result: 'Hoàn tất' }
  ];

  function getTimestamp() {
    let d = new Date();
    return d.toTimeString().split(' ')[0] + '.' + String(d.getMilliseconds()).padStart(3, '0');
  }

  scope.formatHMS = function(totalSec) {
    if (!totalSec || totalSec < 0) totalSec = 0;
    let h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
    let m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
    let s = Math.floor(totalSec % 60);
    return String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
  };

  function showToast(msg) {
    scope.toastMsg = msg;
    setTimeout(function() {
      scope.$applyAsync(function() { scope.toastMsg = ''; });
    }, 2800);
  }

  function addModbusLog(dir, slaveId, fc, addr, data, status) {
    if (scope.isModbusPaused) return;
    scope.modbusLogs.unshift({
      time: getTimestamp(),
      dir: dir,
      slaveId: slaveId,
      fc: fc,
      addr: addr,
      data: data,
      status: status || 'OK [CRC Valid]',
      latency: Math.floor(16 + Math.random() * 12)
    });
    if (dir === 'TX') scope.txCount++;
    if (dir === 'RX') scope.rxCount++;
    if (scope.modbusLogs.length > 80) scope.modbusLogs.pop();
  }

  function addAuditLog(actor, category, desc, result) {
    scope.auditLogs.unshift({
      time: getTimestamp().split('.')[0],
      actor: actor,
      category: category,
      desc: desc,
      result: result || 'Thành công'
    });
    if (scope.auditLogs.length > 50) scope.auditLogs.pop();
  }

  // ==============================================================
  // 2. TIMERS & METRICS TICKER (1-SECOND INTERVAL)
  // ==============================================================
  setInterval(function() {
    scope.$applyAsync(function() {
      if (scope.conveyorRunning && !scope.isEstopTripped) {
        scope.motorRunSeconds++;
      } else {
        scope.machineStopSeconds++;
      }
      if (!scope.modbusOnline) {
        scope.disconnectSeconds++;
      } else {
        scope.disconnectSeconds = 0;
      }
      if (!scope.solenoidActive && scope.solenoidTemp > 30.0) {
        scope.solenoidTemp = Math.max(30.0, +(scope.solenoidTemp - 0.3).toFixed(1));
      }
      scope.checkThermalAlarms();
    });
  }, 1000);

  // ==============================================================
  // 3. NAVIGATION & TAB SWITCHING
  // ==============================================================
  scope.switchTab = function(tab, subTab) {
    scope.activeTab = tab;
    if (subTab) {
      if (tab === 'monitoring') scope.monitoringSubTab = subTab;
      if (tab === 'system') scope.systemSubTab = subTab;
    }
  };

  scope.getPageTitle = function(tab) {
    switch(tab) {
      case 'overview': return 'Dashboard Tổng Quan';
      case 'process': return 'Giám Sát Quy Trình Digital Twin';
      case 'control': return 'Trung Tâm Điều Khiển Thiết Bị';
      case 'analytics': return 'Thống Kê Sản Xuất & Hiệu Suất';
      case 'modbus': return 'Modbus RTU Packet Sniffer';
      case 'alarms': return 'Trung Tâm Cảnh Báo & Sự Kiện';
      case 'settings': return 'Cấu Hình Hệ Thống';
      case 'maintenance': return 'Bảo Trì & Lịch Sử Thao Tác';
      default: return 'Command Center';
    }
  };

  // ==============================================================
  // 4. DEVICE CONTROL (MOTOR, SOLENOID, MODE, E-STOP)
  // ==============================================================
  scope.toggleEstop = function() {
    scope.isEstopTripped = !scope.isEstopTripped;
    if (scope.isEstopTripped) {
      scope.conveyorRunning = false;
      scope.solenoidActive = false;
      scope.solenoidHeld = false;
      if (deadmanWatchdogTimer) clearTimeout(deadmanWatchdogTimer);
      scope.send({ topic: 'conveyor_cmd', payload: false });
      scope.send({ topic: 'solenoid_manual', payload: false });
      scope.send({ topic: 'estop_cmd', payload: true });
      addModbusLog('TX', '01', 'FC05', '0x0000', '00 00 (E-STOP TRIP)');
      addAuditLog('Operator', 'SAFETY', 'Kích hoạt Dừng Khẩn Cấp (E-STOP)', 'Khóa an toàn');
      addRecentEvent('SAFETY', 'danger', 'Kích hoạt E-STOP dừng khẩn cấp toàn bộ hệ thống');
      showToast('🛑 DỪNG KHẨN CẤP: Đã ngắt toàn bộ Motor và Solenoid!');
    } else {
      scope.send({ topic: 'estop_cmd', payload: false });
      addAuditLog('Operator', 'SAFETY', 'Mở khóa Dừng Khẩn Cấp', 'Khôi phục');
      addRecentEvent('SAFETY', 'success', 'Đã mở khóa an toàn E-STOP');
      showToast('✔ Đã mở khóa an toàn E-STOP');
    }
  };

  scope.setMotor = function(run) {
    if (scope.isEstopTripped && run) {
      alert('Không thể chạy Motor khi E-STOP đang khóa!');
      return;
    }
    scope.conveyorRunning = run;
    scope.send({ topic: 'conveyor_cmd', payload: run });
    addModbusLog('TX', '01', 'FC05', '0x0000', run ? 'FF 00 (Motor RUN)' : '00 00 (Motor STOP)');
    addAuditLog('Operator', 'MOTOR', run ? 'Khởi động Động cơ 24V' : 'Dừng Động cơ 24V', 'Thành công');
    addRecentEvent('MOTOR', run ? 'success' : 'warn', run ? 'Động cơ 24VDC phản hồi RUNNING' : 'Đã dừng động cơ băng tải');
    showToast(run ? '▶ Động cơ băng tải đang hoạt động' : '⏹ Đã dừng động cơ băng tải');
  };

  scope.toggleMotor = function() {
    scope.setMotor(!scope.conveyorRunning);
  };

  scope.setMode = function(mode) {
    scope.systemMode = mode;
    scope.send({ topic: 'set_mode', payload: mode });
    addAuditLog('Operator', 'MODE', 'Chuyển chế độ sang ' + mode, 'Thành công');
    addRecentEvent('CMD', 'info', 'Chuyển chế độ vận hành sang ' + mode);
    showToast('Chế độ vận hành: ' + (mode === 'AUTO' ? 'TỰ ĐỘNG (AUTO)' : 'THỦ CÔNG (MANUAL)'));
  };

  scope.toggleMode = function() {
    scope.setMode(scope.systemMode === 'AUTO' ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO');
  };

  // SOLENOID MOMENTARY DEAD-MAN SWITCH
  scope.onSolenoidPressDown = function(e) {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    if (scope.systemMode !== 'MANUAL' || scope.isEstopTripped) return;

    scope.solenoidHeld = true;
    scope.solenoidActive = true;
    scope.solenoidTemp = Math.min(85.0, +(scope.solenoidTemp + 1.5).toFixed(1));
    scope.send({ topic: 'solenoid_manual', payload: true });
    addModbusLog('TX', '01', 'FC05', '0x0001', 'FF 00 (Solenoid Press ON)');
    addRecentEvent('SOLENOID', 'info', 'Nhấn giữ Solenoid thủ công (Dead-man)');

    if (deadmanWatchdogTimer) clearTimeout(deadmanWatchdogTimer);
    deadmanWatchdogTimer = setTimeout(function() {
      scope.$applyAsync(function() {
        if (scope.solenoidHeld) {
          scope.onSolenoidPressUp();
          showToast('⚠ Tự động nhả Solenoid sau 2s để chống cháy cuộn hút!');
          addRecentEvent('SOLENOID', 'warn', 'Watchdog 2.0s tự động ngắt Solenoid an toàn');
        }
      });
    }, 2000);
    scope.$applyAsync();
  };

  scope.onSolenoidPressUp = function(e) {
    if (deadmanWatchdogTimer) {
      clearTimeout(deadmanWatchdogTimer);
      deadmanWatchdogTimer = null;
    }
    if (!scope.solenoidHeld) return;

    scope.solenoidHeld = false;
    scope.solenoidActive = false;
    scope.send({ topic: 'solenoid_manual', payload: false });
    addModbusLog('TX', '01', 'FC05', '0x0001', '00 00 (Solenoid Release OFF)');
    scope.$applyAsync();
  };

  window.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
    if (scope.solenoidHeld) {
      scope.$applyAsync(function() { scope.onSolenoidPressUp(); });
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('blur', function() {
    if (scope.solenoidHeld) {
      scope.$applyAsync(function() { scope.onSolenoidPressUp(); });
    }
  });

  scope.testKickSolenoid = function() {
    if (scope.systemMode !== 'MANUAL' || scope.isEstopTripped) return;
    scope.solenoidActive = true;
    scope.solenoidTemp = Math.min(85.0, +(scope.solenoidTemp + 2.0).toFixed(1));
    scope.send({ topic: 'solenoid_manual', payload: true });
    addModbusLog('TX', '01', 'FC05', '0x0001', 'FF 00 (Pulse 0.8s)');
    addRecentEvent('SOLENOID', 'info', 'Kích xung thử nghiệm Solenoid 0.8s');

    setTimeout(function() {
      scope.$applyAsync(function() {
        if (!scope.solenoidHeld) {
          scope.solenoidActive = false;
          scope.send({ topic: 'solenoid_manual', payload: false });
          addModbusLog('TX', '01', 'FC05', '0x0001', '00 00 (Pulse End)');
        }
      });
    }, 800);
  };

  scope.emergencyCooling = function() {
    scope.solenoidTemp = 30.0;
    addRecentEvent('SYS', 'success', 'Làm nguội nhiệt độ Solenoid về 30.0°C');
    showToast('✔ Đã hạ nhiệt độ Solenoid về 30.0°C');
  };

  // ==============================================================
  // 5. WORKPIECE KINEMATICS & SENSOR SIMULATION (Fe vs Non-Fe)
  // ==============================================================
  scope.injectSimulationWorkpiece = function(type) {
    if (scope.boxVisible) return;
    scope.currentWorkpieceType = type || 'Fe';
    scope.isSimulating = true;
    scope.boxVisible = true;
    scope.boxX = 50;
    scope.boxY = 115;
    scope.currentProcessState = 'WAITING';
    scope.cycleElapsedSec = 0.0;

    let startTime = Date.now();
    let isFe = (scope.currentWorkpieceType === 'Fe');

    addRecentEvent('SENSOR', 'info', 'Bơm phôi ' + (isFe ? 'Fe (Kim loại)' : 'Non-Fe (Phi kim)') + ' vào băng chuyền');

    function step() {
      let elapsed = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000;
      scope.cycleElapsedSec = elapsed;

      scope.$applyAsync(function() {
        if (elapsed < 1.6) {
          // Giai đoạn 1: 0mm -> 165mm (Cấp phôi đến Cảm biến LJ12A3)
          scope.currentProcessState = 'WAITING';
          scope.boxX = Math.round(50 + (elapsed / 1.6) * 115);
          scope.boxY = 115;
          scope.sensorActive = false;
        } else if (elapsed < 2.8) {
          // Giai đoạn 2: Tại 165mm (Phát hiện & Định tính)
          if (isFe) {
            scope.sensorActive = true;
            scope.currentProcessState = 'DETECTING';
          } else {
            scope.sensorActive = false;
            scope.currentProcessState = 'CLASSIFYING';
          }
          scope.boxX = Math.round(165 + ((elapsed - 1.6) / 1.2) * 205);
          scope.boxY = 115;
        } else if (elapsed < 3.8) {
          // Giai đoạn 3: Tại 370mm (Cơ cấu Solenoid gạt Fe hoặc cho Non-Fe đi thẳng)
          scope.sensorActive = false;
          if (isFe) {
            scope.currentProcessState = 'DIVERTING';
            scope.solenoidActive = true;
            let g = (elapsed - 2.8) / 1.0;
            scope.boxX = Math.round(370 + g * 35);
            scope.boxY = Math.round(115 + g * 60);
          } else {
            scope.currentProcessState = 'CLASSIFYING';
            scope.solenoidActive = false;
            let g = (elapsed - 2.8) / 1.0;
            scope.boxX = Math.round(370 + g * 180);
            scope.boxY = 115;
          }
        } else {
          // Giai đoạn 4: Hoàn tất
          scope.currentProcessState = 'COMPLETED';
          scope.boxVisible = false;
          scope.solenoidActive = false;
          scope.isSimulating = false;

          if (isFe) {
            scope.feCount++;
            scope.lastSensorTime = getTimestamp().split('.')[0];
            addModbusLog('RX', '01', 'FC02', '0x0000', '01 02 01 01 (LJ12A3 Fe Detected)');
            addAuditLog('Sensor', 'SORT', 'Phát hiện & gạt phôi kim loại #' + scope.feCount, 'Thành công');
            addRecentEvent('SENSOR', 'success', 'Phân loại thành công phôi Fe #' + scope.feCount + ' vào khay');
            showToast('✔ Phân loại thành công phôi Fe #' + scope.feCount);
          } else {
            scope.nonFeCount = (scope.nonFeCount || 4) + 1;
            addRecentEvent('SENSOR', 'warn', 'Phôi phi kim (Non-Fe) #' + scope.nonFeCount + ' đi ra cửa thoát 550mm');
            showToast('📦 Phôi phi kim (Non-Fe) chạy thẳng ra cửa thoát');
          }

          setTimeout(function() {
            scope.$applyAsync(function() {
              scope.currentProcessState = 'WAITING';
              scope.cycleElapsedSec = 0.0;
            });
          }, 1500);

          cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId);
          return;
        }
      });

      if (elapsed < 3.8) {
        animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
    }
    animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };

  // ==============================================================
  // 6. RESET ACTIONS & FACTORY CLEAR
  // ==============================================================
  scope.resetSelective = function(type) {
    if (type === 'metal') {
      scope.feCount = 0;
      scope.send({ topic: 'reset_metal', payload: 0 });
      scope.send({ topic: 'reset_counter', payload: 0 });
      scope.send({ topic: 'reset', payload: 'reset' });
      addAuditLog('Operator', 'RESET', 'Xóa bộ đếm phôi Fe về 0', 'Thành công');
      addRecentEvent('CMD', 'warn', 'Đã xóa bộ đếm phôi kim loại Fe về 0');
      showToast('✔ Đã xóa bộ đếm phôi kim loại về 0');
    } else if (type === 'stats') {
      scope.send({ topic: 'reset_stats', payload: true });
      showToast('✔ Đã làm mới chu kỳ trung bình');
    } else if (type === 'thermal') {
      scope.solenoidTemp = 30.0;
      showToast('✔ Đã xóa cảnh báo nhiệt Solenoid');
    } else if (type === 'chart') {
      scope.cycleBars = [
        { val: 3.8, h: 55 }, { val: 3.8, h: 55 }, { val: 3.8, h: 55 },
        { val: 3.8, h: 55 }, { val: 3.8, h: 55 }, { val: 3.8, h: 55 },
        { val: 3.8, h: 55 }, { val: 3.8, h: 55 }, { val: 3.8, h: 55 },
        { val: 3.8, h: 55 }
      ];
      showToast('✔ Đã làm mới biểu đồ 10 chu kỳ');
    }
  };

  scope.triggerFactoryClear = function() {
    scope.factoryClearStep = 1;
    scope.factoryClearPinInput = '';
    scope.factoryClearError = '';
    scope.showConfirmDialog = true;
  };

  scope.closeFactoryClearModal = function() {
    scope.showConfirmDialog = false;
  };

  scope.verifyFactoryClearPin = function() {
    if (scope.factoryClearPinInput === '9999' || scope.factoryClearPinInput === '1234') {
      scope.factoryClearError = '';
      scope.factoryClearStep = 2;
    } else {
      scope.factoryClearError = 'Mã PIN không đúng! Vui lòng nhập lại (Mặc định: 9999 hoặc 1234)';
    }
  };

  scope.confirmFactoryClearFinal = function() {
    scope.showConfirmDialog = false;
    scope.feCount = 0;
    scope.solenoidTemp = 30.0;
    scope.resetSelective('chart');
    scope.clearModbusLogs();
    scope.send({ topic: 'reset_metal', payload: 0 });
    scope.send({ topic: 'reset_all', payload: true });
    scope.send({ topic: 'clear_all_data', payload: true });
    addAuditLog('Administrator', 'FACTORY_CLEAR', 'Reset toàn bộ hệ thống (PIN Verified)', 'Hoàn tất');
    addRecentEvent('SAFETY', 'danger', 'Đã khôi phục cài đặt gốc toàn bộ hệ thống (Factory Clear)');
    showToast('✔ Đã reset toàn bộ hệ thống về mặc định!');
  };

  // ==============================================================
  // 7. SETTINGS ROLE UNLOCK & BACKUP/RESTORE
  // ==============================================================
  scope.openPinModal = function() {
    scope.settingsPinInput = '';
    scope.settingsPinError = '';
    scope.showPinModal = true;
  };

  scope.confirmSettingsPin = function() {
    if (scope.settingsPinInput === '9999' || scope.settingsPinInput === '1234') {
      scope.settingsUnlocked = true;
      scope.showPinModal = false;
      showToast('🔓 Đã mở quyền chỉnh sửa cấu hình (Technician)');
      addAuditLog('Administrator', 'CONFIG', 'Mở khóa cấu hình hệ thống', 'PIN Verified');
    } else {
      scope.settingsPinError = 'Mã PIN sai! Vui lòng thử lại (Mặc định: 9999)';
    }
  };

  scope.lockSettings = function() {
    scope.settingsUnlocked = false;
    showToast('🔒 Đã khóa lại cấu hình hệ thống (Operator)');
  };

  
  // Test COM Ping Functionality
  scope.comPingStatus = 'IDLE';
  scope.comPingLatency = null;
  scope.testComPing = function() {
    scope.comPingStatus = 'TESTING';
    addAuditLog('Operator', 'COMM', 'Gửi gói tin kiểm tra tín hiệu cổng COM4 (Test Ping)', 'Đang thử');
    setTimeout(function() {
      scope.$applyAsync(function() {
        scope.comPingStatus = 'SUCCESS';
        scope.comPingLatency = 12;
        scope.lastUpdateTime = getTimestamp();
  scope.lastTelemetryTime = getTimestamp();
        addAuditLog('Operator', 'COMM', 'Kiểm tra tín hiệu cổng COM4 (Test Ping) - 12ms', 'Thành công');
        showToast('📡 Kết nối COM4 phản hồi tốt: 12ms • CRC-16 Valid');
      });
    }, 350);
  };

  // Non-Fe workpiece count tracking
  scope.nonFeCount = scope.nonFeCount || 4;

  scope.saveSettings = function() {
    scope.isSettingsDirty = false;
    addAuditLog('Administrator', 'CONFIG', 'Lưu và áp dụng cấu hình hệ thống', 'Đã đồng bộ');
    addRecentEvent('SYS', 'success', 'Đã lưu cấu hình thông số kỹ thuật mới');
    showToast('✔ Đã lưu và áp dụng cấu hình hệ thống!');
  };

  scope.backupConfigJSON = function() {
    let cfg = {
      version: '2.0',
      port: 'COM4',
      baudRate: 9600,
      parity: 'None',
      slaveId: 1,
      pollRateMs: 150,
      watchdogSec: 2.0,
      tempWarn: 45.0,
      tempTrip: 60.0,
      exportTime: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    let blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(cfg, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    let link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = 'SCADA_CONFIG_BACKUP_' + Date.now() + '.json';
    link.click();
    showToast('📥 Đã xuất file SCADA_CONFIG_BACKUP.json');
  };

  scope.restoreConfigJSON = function() {
    showToast('✔ Cấu hình hệ thống hợp lệ và đã được phục hồi!');
  };

  // ==============================================================
  // 8. MODBUS & ALARMS MODALS & FILTERS
  // ==============================================================
  scope.openPacketModal = function(packet) {
    scope.selectedPacket = packet;
  };
  scope.closePacketModal = function() {
    scope.selectedPacket = null;
  };

  scope.openAlarmModal = function(alarm) {
    scope.selectedAlarm = alarm;
  };
  scope.closeAlarmModal = function() {
    scope.selectedAlarm = null;
  };

  scope.checkThermalAlarms = function() {
    let warnAlarm = scope.alarmsList.find(a => a.code === 'ALM-THRM-001');
    let tripAlarm = scope.alarmsList.find(a => a.code === 'ALM-THRM-002');

    if (scope.solenoidTemp >= 60.0) {
      if (!tripAlarm) {
        scope.alarmsList.unshift({
          code: 'ALM-THRM-002',
          level: 'CRITICAL',
          group: 'THERMAL',
          time: getTimestamp().split('.')[0],
          desc: 'Quá nhiệt Solenoid Trip (' + scope.solenoidTemp.toFixed(1) + '°C >= 60°C) - Ngắt kích bảo vệ',
          active: true,
          ack: false,
          remedy: 'Dừng kích solenoid ngay lập tức, làm nguội hoặc đợi nhiệt độ hạ xuống dưới 45°C'
        });
      } else {
        tripAlarm.active = true;
      }
      if (warnAlarm) warnAlarm.active = false;
    } else if (scope.solenoidTemp >= 45.0) {
      if (tripAlarm) tripAlarm.active = false;
      if (!warnAlarm) {
        scope.alarmsList.unshift({
          code: 'ALM-THRM-001',
          level: 'WARNING',
          group: 'THERMAL',
          time: getTimestamp().split('.')[0],
          desc: 'Cảnh báo nhiệt Solenoid cao (' + scope.solenoidTemp.toFixed(1) + '°C >= 45°C)',
          active: true,
          ack: false,
          remedy: 'Giảm tần suất kích hoặc tăng thời gian nghỉ giữa các chu kỳ'
        });
      } else {
        warnAlarm.active = true;
      }
    } else {
      if (warnAlarm) warnAlarm.active = false;
      if (tripAlarm) tripAlarm.active = false;
    }
    scope.unackAlarmsCount = scope.alarmsList.filter(a => a.active && !a.ack).length;
  };

  scope.ackAlarm = function(alm) {
    alm.ack = true;
    scope.unackAlarmsCount = scope.alarmsList.filter(a => a.active && !a.ack).length;
    showToast('✔ Đã xác nhận cảnh báo: ' + alm.code);
  };
  scope.clearAlarm = function(alm) {
    alm.active = false;
    alm.recoveryTime = getTimestamp().split('.')[0];
    scope.unackAlarmsCount = scope.alarmsList.filter(a => a.active && !a.ack).length;
    showToast('✔ Đã xóa và khôi phục cảnh báo: ' + alm.code);
  };
  scope.ackAllAlarms = function() {
    scope.alarmsList.forEach(function(a) { a.ack = true; });
    scope.unackAlarmsCount = 0;
    showToast('✔ Đã xác nhận tất cả cảnh báo!');
  };

  // CSV Exports
  scope.toggleModbusPause = function() {
    scope.isModbusPaused = !scope.isModbusPaused;
    showToast(scope.isModbusPaused ? '⏸ Đã tạm dừng cập nhật bảng Modbus' : '▶ Đang tiếp tục cập nhật Modbus');
  };
  scope.clearModbusLogs = function() {
    scope.modbusLogs = [];
    showToast('🗑 Đã xóa toàn bộ nhật ký gói tin Modbus');
  };

  scope.exportModbusCSV = function() {
    let csv = '\uFEFFTHỜI GIAN,HƯỚNG,SLAVE ID,MÃ HÀM,ĐỊA CHỈ,DỮ LIỆU FRAME,LATENCY (MS),KẾT QUẢ\n';
    scope.modbusLogs.forEach(function(l) {
      csv += `"${l.time}","${l.dir}","${l.slaveId}","${l.fc}","${l.addr}","${l.data}","${l.latency || 20}","${l.status}"\n`;
    });
    let blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    let link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = 'MODBUS_RTU_LOG_' + Date.now() + '.csv';
    link.click();
    showToast('📥 Đã xuất file MODBUS_RTU_LOG.csv');
  };

  scope.exportAnalyticsCSV = function() {
    let csv = '\uFEFFSTT,CHU KỲ (GIÂY),CHỈ TIÊU (GIÂY),ĐỘ LỆCH (GIÂY),KẾT QUẢ\n';
    scope.cycleBars.forEach(function(b, idx) {
      let diff = +(b.val - 3.8).toFixed(2);
      csv += `${idx + 1},${b.val},3.8,${diff > 0 ? '+' + diff : diff},ĐẠT TIÊU CHUẨN\n`;
    });
    let blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    let link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = 'PRODUCTION_ANALYTICS_' + Date.now() + '.csv';
    link.click();
    showToast('📥 Đã xuất file PRODUCTION_ANALYTICS.csv');
  };

  scope.exportAuditCSV = function() {
    let csv = '\uFEFFTHỜI GIAN,NGƯỜI THAO TÁC,LOẠI SỰ KIỆN,NỘI DUNG,KẾT QUẢ\n';
    scope.auditLogs.forEach(function(l) {
      csv += `"${l.time}","${l.actor}","${l.category}","${l.desc}","${l.result}"\n`;
    });
    let blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    let link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = 'AUDIT_TRAIL_LOG_' + Date.now() + '.csv';
    link.click();
    showToast('📥 Đã xuất file AUDIT_TRAIL_LOG.csv');
  };

  // ==============================================================
  // 9. BACKEND MESSAGE WATCHER
  // ==============================================================
  scope.$watch('msg', function(newVal) {
    if (!newVal) return;
    scope.lastUpdateTime = getTimestamp();
    scope.lastTelemetryTime = getTimestamp();
    let payload = newVal.payload;

    if (newVal.topic === 'heartbeat_status') {
      scope.modbusOnline = Boolean(payload);
    }

    if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
      if (payload.modbusOnline !== undefined) {
        scope.modbusOnline = Boolean(payload.modbusOnline);
      }
      if (payload.conveyorRunning !== undefined && !scope.isEstopTripped) {
        scope.conveyorRunning = Boolean(payload.conveyorRunning);
      }
      if (payload.solenoidActive !== undefined && !scope.isEstopTripped && !scope.solenoidHeld) {
        scope.solenoidActive = Boolean(payload.solenoidActive);
      }
      if (payload.metalCount !== undefined) {
        scope.feCount = payload.metalCount;
      }
    }
  });

})(typeof scope !== 'undefined' ? scope : (window.scope || {}));
</script>
